name: Lagercrantz Group AB (publ)
summary: Lagercrantz Group AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, operates as a technology company in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, the United Kingdom, Benelux, Poland, rest of Europe, North America, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Electrify, Control, TecSec, Niche Products, and International. It offers electrical connectors, electrical enclosures and technical housing, cabling, electrical products, and infrastructure products. The company also provides control systems for lifts and level sensors for molten metals, protective cases for the transport of advanced communications equipment, and conveyors for foodstuff.
